title: Mending rework
subtitle: (It doesn't repair)
description: Mending will not repair gear! And cannot be applied as an enchant like normal
It will instead reset the cost of combining/adding levels to the item, making it cheaper to continue enchanting it
If you get a mending "Ancient Tome", and combine it with a mending book, you can get mending 2 which acts like the vanilla mending enchant
